headline: Updated omics databases link molecular profiles to regulatory, cellular, spatial and phenotypic context
label: Omics Knowledge Resource Databases
summary: Seven database and tool releases extend omics resources with finer biological context, from miRNA TSSs and CpG markers to single-cell and spatial niches.
synthesis: The dominant thread is integration of heterogeneous omics layers with biological context, paired with query or analysis modules over curated stores. DIANA-miRGen v5 annotates miRNA transcription start sites using long-read, GENCODE and CAGE data. MethMarkerDB 2.0 covers 21 cancer types with CpG-level and functional modules. scGWAS-DB maps 3,649 GWAS datasets onto 74 tissues and 1,713 cell types. CROST 2.0 reaches 544 spatial projects and 3538 samples with niche and colocalization tools. iCellOmics links multi-omics and curated gene-phenotype data for 17 cell lines, and Gene Expression Nebulas 2.0 adds datasets and annotations. GOntact infers cis-regulatory element targets from Promoter Capture Hi-C contacts. New here is finer resolution of context, not a shared network framework.
